heroSub: In the project implemented at BSH's oven production factory in Çerkezköy, traceability was provided on the assembly lines based on product serial numbers.
contextP1: In the project implemented at BSH's oven production factory in Çerkezköy, traceability was provided on the assembly lines based on product serial numbers.
contextP2: The project was carried out in order to monitor the production process at the station level and perform performance analyses.
problemLede: Each product needed to be tracked on a station basis on the assembly lines, and it was required to record which product passed through which stations.

problemList.text: Inability to automatically and accurately record which stations the products passed through along the line.
Inability to identify bottlenecks due to the lack of measurement for station and product-based cycle time data.
Line balancing work not based on real data limiting efficiency improvements.

solutionLede: Traceability on assembly lines was achieved by tracking the product serial number on a station basis. Cycle time analyses helped identify station and product-based bottlenecks; box plot charts visualized station-based duration distributions, providing foresight in line balancing. With SAP integration, master data was retrieved via SAP and integrated into the system.

steps.title: Serial Number Reading
steps.text: Product serial numbers are automatically scanned at stations using barcode readers.

steps.title: PLC Field Management
steps.text: The PLC structure coordinates the field flow and reading triggers in real time.

steps.title: Cycle Time Analysis
steps.text: Cycle times are analyzed based on station readings and duration measurements.

steps.title: Box Plot Distribution
steps.text: Duration distributions are visualized using box plots, providing foresight for line balancing.

techGrid.title: PLC Field Structure
techGrid.text: PLC infrastructure that manages field automation, station transitions, and reading triggers.

techGrid.title: Barcode Readers
techGrid.text: Industrial scanners that read product serial numbers at stations with high precision.

techGrid.title: Cycle Time & Box Plot
techGrid.text: Bottleneck detection and box plot graphic visualizations through duration measurements.

techGrid.title: SAP Integration
techGrid.text: Bi-directional transfer of master product and production data via SAP.

techGrid.title: OnSuite Trace Platform
techGrid.text: Central software layer controlling traceability and process management.

integrationDesc: The system works bi-directionally integrated with SAP. Master product and production data is retrieved via SAP and transferred to the traceability system; station-based tracking and analysis processes are carried out using this updated data.

integrationList.text: Product recipe and master data are automatically pulled via SAP and synchronized with the system.
A consistent and up-to-date link is established between the field application and corporate ERP.

resultsGrid.title: Full Traceability
resultsGrid.text: Station-based end-to-end traceability was achieved at the product serial number level.

resultsGrid.title: Bottleneck Identification
resultsGrid.text: Bottlenecks became clearly visible through cycle time analyses and box plot charts.

resultsGrid.title: Line Balancing
resultsGrid.text: Efficiency was improved by providing foresight into line balancing based on duration distributions.
